references.text: The Levites received no inheritance in the land but were given the tithe from the people of Israel as their inheritance, which explains why the Israelites had to provide for them.
The same reminder not to forget the Levite living within your gates, since he has no share or inheritance among you.
The command to give the tithe to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, emphasizing Israel's responsibility to support the Levites.
The cities and pasturelands of the Levites could not be sold permanently, as these were their eternal possession instead of land holdings.
Levitical priests were to have no inheritance in Israel, but the Lord himself was their inheritance, and they were to live from the offerings.
Nehemiah discovered that the Levites had abandoned their service because they had not received their share, an example of what happens when the people neglect the Levites.
